ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ صَلَاةً تُدْخِلُنَا بِهَا حَضْرَةَ الْإِطْلَاقِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣalātan tudkhilunā bi hā ḥadrata ‘l-itlāq.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family a prayer driving us into midst of liberation!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ أُولِي الْبأْسِ الشَّدِيْدِ عِنْدَ التَّلَاقِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ulī ‘l-ba’si sh-shadīdi `inda ‘t-talāq.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those of intense fortitude in battle!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ مَا تَحَرَّكَتِ الْأَفْلَاكُ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Mā taḥarrakati ‘l-aflāk.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family in all that moves in orbit!
